summary: payment-service fund transfers began failing at 2026-04-02T12:15 when its client mTLS certificate (CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal) expired (notAfter=2026-04-02T12:15:00Z) and was not renewed. bank-partner-api correctly rejects the handshake with 'tls: expired certificate (alert 45)'; every outbound bank call now fails, so bank_api_error_rate goes to 100% and payment_success_rate drops from ~99% to ~2.5%. Because payments are marked PENDING_RETRY (a business-level outcome) rather than returning HTTP 5xx, the HTTP error_rate panel stays flat at ~0.22% and api-gateway logs nothing — this is why the dashboard stayed green despite the outage. The fault originates on our side (certificate lifecycle), not the bank: the error names our client cert. The unrelated cfg-2502 timeout change (11:20) and settlement-service deploy (10:30) are ruled out by timing and mechanism. Root cause category: credential_expiry.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Expired payment-service client mTLS certificate breaks bank-partner-api calls
ranked_hypotheses.statement: payment-service's client certificate (CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal) expired at 2026-04-02T12:15:00Z and was not renewed. Its mTLS handshake to bank-partner-api is now rejected (TLS alert 45 'expired certificate'), so all fund transfers fail; payments are marked PENDING_RETRY rather than returning HTTP 5xx, which is why the HTTP error-rate dashboard stayed green.

causal_chain.claim: Client cert CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal reached notAfter=2026-04-02T12:15:00Z and was not renewed
Expired client cert -> mTLS handshake rejected by bank-partner-api (tls alert 45)
Failures surface as PENDING_RETRY (business-level), not HTTP 5xx, so HTTP error_rate stays flat and the dashboard is green

assumptions: The cert CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal belongs to payment-service and is not shared with another service (no evidence of another owner).
No certificate auto-renewal occurred between 12:15 and 13:59 (the continuing 100% bank_api_error_rate implies the cert stayed expired).

ranked_hypotheses.title: bank-partner-api (external vendor) outage / dependency failure
ranked_hypotheses.statement: The external bank-partner-api degraded, causing payment failures. The bank-side fault would originate outside our systems.
assumptions: None credible: the error text attributes the rejected cert to us, not to a partner-side error.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: Logs show the bank returned a TLS alert about OUR client certificate (our client cert ... notAfter=...), not a partner-side 5xx. The bank is correctly rejecting an expired credential. This matches HIST-106 (our cert expiry), not HIST-105 (partner 5xx outage).

ranked_hypotheses.title: Config change cfg-2502 (bank API timeout 3000->5000ms) caused payment failures
ranked_hypotheses.statement: Raising bank.api.timeout_ms at 11:20 caused the failure.
assumptions: None: a timeout value cannot cause a TLS certificate-expiry rejection.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: Onset is 12:15, 55 min after the 11:20 change; the error is an mTLS cert-expiry alert (alert 45), which a timeout setting cannot produce. Request_rate and latency show no timeout-related behavior.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Resource exhaustion / capacity saturation on payment-service
ranked_hypotheses.statement: Resource exhaustion (connections/memory/CPU) or load growth caused the failures.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: cpu_pct flat ~30%, db_pool_in_use flat ~8, restarts 0, request_rate unchanged; and the error explicitly names an expired TLS certificate.

ranked_hypotheses.title: settlement-service deployment dep-5510 caused the failures
ranked_hypotheses.statement: The 10:30 settlement-service v1.9.0 deploy broke payments.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: Settlement deploy was 1h45m before onset, only added a CSV exporter, and payment-service has no deploy; the failure mechanism (client cert expiry) is unrelated to settlement.

facts.statement: payment_success_rate fell from ~99% to ~2.5% at the 12:12 bucket; HTTP error_rate stayed ~0.22%.
Logs report a TLS expired-certificate alert 45 citing our client cert CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal notAfter=2026-04-02T12:15:00Z.
payments are marked PENDING_RETRY on mTLS handshake rejection starting 12:15:27.
A cert-watcher warned at 11:50:26 that the client certificate expired in 25 minutes (notAfter 12:15).
api-gateway logged no WARN/ERROR entries in the window.
request_rate, cpu_pct, db_pool_in_use and restarts were flat/unremarkable across the incident.
No payment-service deployment occurred; the only deploy was settlement-service v1.9.0 at 10:30.
The only config change was bank.api.timeout_ms 3000->5000 at 11:20.

assumptions: CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal is payment-service's own client credential and not shared with another service.
The certificate remained expired through 13:59 (consistent with bank_api_error_rate staying at 100%).
bank-partner-api has no telemetry, so partner-side state is inferred from our logs only.

timeline.event: settlement-service v1.9.0 (dep-5510, CSV exporter) deployed — unrelated
payment-service config cfg-2502: bank.api.timeout_ms 3000 -> 5000 — unrelated to TLS
cert-watcher warns client cert expires in 25 minutes (notAfter 12:15:00)
First 'PENDING_RETRY: mTLS handshake with bank-partner-api rejected' error

recommended_actions.action: Renew/rotate the payment-service client certificate CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal and reload it (hot reload or rollout) so mTLS to bank-partner-api succeeds.
recommended_actions.rationale: The expired cert is the direct cause; bank_api_error_rate is 100% and all transfers fail until it is replaced.

recommended_actions.action: Drain/replay the PENDING_RETRY payment backlog once mTLS is restored, and verify idempotency.
recommended_actions.rationale: 140+ payments were marked PENDING_RETRY and need reconcoliation once the bank channel is restored.

recommended_actions.action: Add an alert on bank_api_error_rate and payment_success_rate (and on the cert-watcher expiry warning) so business-level failures page before customers escalate.
recommended_actions.rationale: The HTTP error-rate panel stayed green because failures surface as PENDING_RETRY; success-rate/bank-error metrics are the correct SLIs.

recommended_actions.action: Implement automated certificate renewal/rotation with pre-expiry alerting (per HIST-106 precedent).
recommended_actions.rationale: This is a repeat class of incident (HIST-106: settlement mTLS cert expired; no renewal automation).

data_gaps: bank-partner-api has no telemetry (has_telemetry=false): we cannot directly confirm the partner's view or whether a renewed cert would be accepted.
No deployment or config record of certificate-issuance/renewal tooling exists in the window, so we cannot see why renewal did not occur (process gap vs. failure).
payment-service logs are truncated (returned 40 of 316); later entries (12:26-13:58) were not individually inspected, though the aggregated patterns cover them.

findings.statement: payment-service 'payment_success_rate' collapses from ~99% to ~2.5% starting in the 2026-04-02T12:12 bucket (avg 26.82), while 'error_rate' stays flat at ~0.22% throughout.
payment-service 'bank_api_error_rate' jumps from ~0.2% to 100% at the 2026-04-02T12:12 bucket (avg 75.05, then 100.0).

payment-service logs show 171 occurrences of bank-partner-api call failure due to an expired client certificate: 'remote error: tls: expired certificate (alert 45); our client cert CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal notAfter=2026-04-02T12:15:00Z', first seen 2026-04-02T12:16:44Z.

findings.statement: A cert-watcher warning logged at 2026-04-02T11:50:26Z states the client certificate would expire: 'expires in 25 minutes (notAfter=2026-04-02T12:15:00Z)'.
api-gateway logged zero WARN/ERROR entries between 2026-04-02T12:00:00Z and 13:59:00Z (total_matched 0).
payment-service request_rate is unchanged across the incident (~100 req/s, 98.97-102.11 avg), i.e. traffic volume did not spike or collapse.
payment-service cpu_pct stays flat at ~30% and restarts stays at 0 across the whole window; db_pool_in_use ~8 connections with no ramp.
Only one code deployment occurred in the window: settlement-service v1.9.0 (dep-5510) at 2026-04-02T10:30:00Z ('new CSV exporter'); no payment-service deployment.
One config change occurred: cfg-2502 on payment-service, bank.api.timeout_ms 3000 -> 5000 at 2026-04-02T11:20:00Z (after partner advisory).
payment-service depends on bank-partner-api (external, has_telemetry=false) and shared datastores ledger-db and kafka.

The error text explicitly frames the failure as OUR client side: 'our client cert CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal notAfter=2026-04-02T12:15:00Z' being rejected (alert 45) by the bank's server during handshake; the bank_partner returned a TLS alert, not a 5xx.

Historical incident HIST-105 (payment failures, bank partner API outage) was a dependency_failure with bank returning 5xx; the current incident differs in that the bank returned a TLS alert about our certificate, and HIST-106 (settlement mTLS cert expired, category credential_expiry) is the closer precedent.

refs.quote: "root_cause":"Bank partner API returned 5xx for 40 minutes (their incident)"

findings.statement: Failure onset (12:12-12:15) is ~55 minutes after the cfg-2502 timeout change (11:20) and ~1h45m after the unrelated settlement deploy (10:30), and 1 minute after the cert's stated notAfter time (12:15:00), aligning the failure with cert expiry rather than those changes.
